item.title: Khamenei Threatens American Troops, Attacks Iranian Civilians Mourning Slain Protesters Amid Nuclear Negotiations With US
item.description: Iranian supreme leader Ali Khamenei threatened to attack U.S. warships in the Middle East as his representatives took part in indirect nuclear negotiations with the United States.
